name: implement-from-spec
description: Spec-driven, approval-gated implementation skills for Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Java and Python: a code-free plan the user approves, implementation in waves, the stack's checks, review, and no deploy without explicit approval

external_review.title: External reviewer
external_review.description: Optional second-family code review after the Claude review, off by default. off: no change content goes to a non-Claude model. bedrock-gpt: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra on Amazon Bedrock in your AWS account; it sends the plan, the rules files, the review focus, the in-scope specification files and the filtered diff. command: your own reviewer CLI (prompt on stdin, answer on stdout)

external_review_auth.title: External reviewer authentication
external_review_auth.description: For bedrock-gpt. aws-profile: the bedrock-runtime Converse API through the AWS CLI with AWS credentials (SigV4, SSO profiles work). api-key: the bedrock-mantle Responses API with a Bedrock API key exported as IMPLEMENT_FROM_SPEC_BEDROCK_API_KEY. AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK is never used

external_review_aws_profile.title: External reviewer AWS profile
external_review_aws_profile.description: AWS profile for aws-profile authentication. Empty: the default credential chain. It may differ from the account Claude Code uses

external_review_region.title: External reviewer Region
external_review_region.description: AWS Region for the reviewer. Empty: AWS_REGION, then AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, then us-east-1. The default model needs a US or Canada Region (bedrock-runtime) or us-east-1 / us-west-2 (bedrock-mantle)

external_review_model.title: External reviewer model
external_review_model.description: Model or inference profile ID. Empty: us.openai.gpt-6-astra (aws-profile, bedrock-runtime) or openai.gpt-6-astra (api-key, bedrock-mantle)

external_review_command.title: External reviewer command
external_review_command.description: For command: the reviewer command line, split into arguments like a shell line and run without a shell. It reads the prompt on stdin and prints the answer

external_review_policy.title: External review policy
external_review_policy.description: optional: when the reviewer cannot run, the skill reports why and continues with the Claude review. required: the run is reported as verification incomplete instead

setup_session_notice.title: Setup notice at session start
setup_session_notice.description: On: a new session gets one line suggesting /implement-from-spec:setup when the dependency check has never run on this machine or last found a required tool missing. It reads the check's saved result and runs no tool. Off: no notice
